Today, Cargobase helps global enterprise shippers such as Bosch, Goodyear, Reckitt Benckiser, and Textron work seamlessly with logistics service providers including DHL, DSV, and FedEx. Delivering transparency, efficiency, and control at scale.

As a SaaS Sales Development Representative, you are responsible for driving top-of-funnel performance by identifying, engaging, and qualifying new prospects to build a predictable and high-quality sales pipeline. You play a critical role at the start of the sales cycle, assessing customer fit, clearly articulating Cargobase’s value proposition, and ensuring only well-qualified opportunities are passed to Account Executives.

• Apply structured outreach via email, phone, and social channels to maintain a predictable inflow of high-quality leads.

• Validate customer fit quickly using defined qualification criteria (i.e.use case, urgency, business pain).

• Progress only leads to the sales pipeline to ensure quality and accuracy.

• Align prospect needs with core platform capabilities during early conversations.

• Provide accurate forecasts on lead volumes, qualification rates, and conversion metrics.

• Track outreach activities through CRM and ensure strong data hygiene for visibility to Sales Leadership.

• Consistently meet or exceed monthly and quarterly targets for qualified opportunities.

• Comprehensive  medical, dental, and vision insurance .

About CPJ:
Founded in 1981, the Committee to Protect Journalists (“CPJ”) is an independent, non-profit organization defending journalists worldwide without regard to their political ideology. Through its work to safeguard journalists, CPJ protects the rights of all people to have access to diverse and independent sources of information. For over four decades, CPJ has helped win the early release of imprisoned journalists, secure convictions in journalist murders, and enable legal reform in countries where free expression has deteriorated. CPJ’s widely cited database and reports have raised global awareness of attacks on press freedom. Learn more about CPJ’s fight to defend freedom of the press here
At CPJ, we are dedicated to upholding values of equity and free expression in both our internal operations and external endeavors. As a global organization headquartered in the United States, we aspire to build a diverse workplace and foster an inclusive and welcoming environment. We strive for our people to be representative of the global community on which we report and to equip them with the opportunities and resources they need to learn and succeed.
CPJ is headquartered in New York City, but our team is truly global, with staff members and contributors based worldwide. This structure allows us to monitor and respond to press freedom threats in real-time, ensuring that journalists everywhere have the support they need.
Scope of Work:
The Levant Researcher will document, investigate, and report on press freedom violations and threats to journalists in the Levant with a focus on Lebanon, Israel and Palestine, and Jordan The role includes research and writing for CPJ’s editorial and advocacy output, maintaining up-to-date data on press freedom violations, and translating reports between Arabic and English.
This role requires a background in media, press freedom, and human rights in the MENA region, excellent research and English and Arabic writing skills, a solid understanding of journalistic standards, and the ability to work independently and proactively. You will collaborate with colleagues across different time zones, requiring strong interpersonal and project management skills. This is a short-term, remote, full time contract position through December 31, 2026, with the potential for extension.
Key Responsibilities:

• Monitor press freedom violations in Lebanon, Israel, Palestine and Jordan, including arrests, censorship, attacks, and legal harassment of journalists and media outlets.

• Write daily news alerts, statements, and in-depth features on emerging press freedom issues.

• Translate materials to and from Arabic, including interviews, reports, and official documents, to support CPJ's reporting and advocacy.

• Write timely news alerts, public statements, and in-depth features on emerging press freedom issues across the Levant, with a particular focus on escalation zones such as Gaza, the West Bank and Lebanon.

• Coordinate investigative research efforts, including case mapping, open-source intelligence (OSINT) analysis

title: Senior Growth Software Engineer
description:
Job Requisition ID #

25WD92032
About the Role

We are searching for a strong Growth-focused Software Engineer to our Product Growth team driving user product adoption, engagement and monetisation for our next-generation, AI-powered architecture design product, Forma.

In this role, you will sit at the critical intersection of engineering, product, and business strategy. We operate with a strong commercial bias: we believe that code is a means to an end. Your true measure of success will be the tangible commercial outcomes and user growth you drive. If you are passionate about moving the needle on key business metrics, running rapid experiments, and focusing relentlessly on the end result, this is the perfect role for you.

Responsibilities

• Drive growth: You will design, build, and deploy experiments aimed at improving user adoption and engagement as well as our early self-serve monetisation experiments.

• Execute rapid experimentation: Formulate hypotheses and execute A/B tests at a high velocity. You will build minimum viable features to validate ideas quickly, understanding that many tests will fail, and that this failure is a celebrated and necessary part of the discovery process.

• Collaborate cross-functionally: Work seamlessly with Product Managers, Designers, Data Analysts and Marketing to identify growth bottlenecks and brainstorm innovative, high-impact solutions.

• Make data-driven decisions: Analyze experiment results and user data to uncover hidden insights. You will constantly ask "Why?" to understand user behaviour and inform your next set of technical and product decisions.

• Practice pragmatic engineering: Make smart trade-offs between engineering perfection and speed to market. You will handle edge cases pragmatically, often finding creative solutions that require minimal engineering effort to validate a concept.

• Leverage AI to multiply output: Act as an AI-accelerated generalist. You will use modern AI tools to accelerate your workflow, stepping outside traditional engineering boundaries to assist with lightweight product management, data analysis and maybe even design tasks to get experiments live faster.

The Ideal Candidate

We are looking for someone who embodies specific traits that align with our outcome-over-code philosophy. Prior experience in a formal Growth Engineering role is highly desirable, a relentless growth mindset is the absolute prerequisite.

• Growth mindset & commercial bias: You care deeply about the business impact of your work. You understand that engineering is a tool to solve user problems and drive revenue. And you have a demonstrated ability to drive the team's work to completion, breaking complex tasks into smaller, actionable pieces.

• AI-accelerated generalist: You have a strong bias toward using AI to multiply your output. You are comfortable stepping outside traditional engineering boundaries, using AI tools to assist with lightweight product management and design tasks to get experiments live faster.

• Self-starter with infinite curiosity: You are proactive about coming up with your own hypotheses and experiments. You do not wait to be handed a rigid roadmap; you find opportunities in the data and act on them.

• Resilient to lost code: You are completely comfortable with the reality of experimentation. You know that a significant portion of the code you write will be discarded if an experiment does not yield the desired results, and you do not let ego get in the way of progress.

• Comfortable with unscalable solutions: You understand that early tests might be small, scrappy, and unpolished. You prefer a pragmatic approach to validate an idea in days over spending weeks building a highly scalable but unproven feature.

• Product-minded communicator: You possess strong product instincts and can articulate the "why" behind your technical choices to non-technical stakeholders. You thrive in an autonomous culture and enable co-workers through knowledge sharing.

description:
ABOUT FREETRADE

Freetrade’s mission is to become the default place to invest. Investing has been too complicated and expensive for too long, keeping millions from making the most of their savings.

We’re changing that.

We’re building our team and looking for people who are excited to reshape how our customers invest and grow their wealth. If you’re driven by solving complex problems and building innovative products, you’ll fit right in.

2026 is a big year for us. Last year, we announced a game changing deal to become part of the IG Group. We’ll continue to operate as an independent business while gaining access to the resources and support of an established leader in the space.

This year, we’re accelerating our roadmap and taking our products to the next level. We’re building new features like mutual funds, bonds, and family investment tools. We’re also exploring how we can leverage AI to deliver an even better experience for our customers.

Here, your code doesn’t just run - it powers the decisions of investors across the UK.

We are looking for a Senior Backend Software Engineer to play a pivotal role in our engineering team. In this position, you'll lead the end-to-end delivery of complex, impactful features, showcasing a passion for independent problem-solving and a drive to scale our next-generation, user-focused product.

Our philosophy on hiring

We hire for engineering excellence, not just a specific list of keywords. Our interview process is language-agnostic; we care about your ability to solve complex problems, design scalable systems, and write clean code in whichever language you’re most comfortable with.

Our stack

Once you join, you’ll be working primarily with TypeScript, Node.js, and PostgreSQL on GCP. We don’t expect you to be an expert in these on Day 1, but we do look for engineers who are excited to master this stack and contribute to its evolution.

What you’ll do

- Lead features from initial design and development through to post-production and validation.

- Level up the team through technical workshops, pair programming, and active mentorship.

- Define and uphold company-wide standards for code reviews and engineering best practices.

- Act as a senior escalation point for high-priority issues and participate in our on-call rotation.

- Conduct technical interviews to identify and hire top-tier engineering talent.

- Constantly evaluate the tech landscape to improve our development processes and tools.

About you

- Involve others in design decisions and delegate responsibility to help your squad grow.

- Speak candidly when quality dips and work proactively with your team to raise the bar.

- Stay calm and effective when tackling complex, ambiguous technical challenges under pressure.

- Maintain a deep obsession with the "how" and "why" of the systems you build.

- Bring a genuine interest in the world of investments and fintech.

- Stay current with industry trends to influence better internal engineering practices.

Our hybrid model

We work from our central London and Budapest offices on Monday, Tuesday, and Thursday, leaving Wednesday and Friday for dedicated focus time at home.

3. System design interview

4. Exec interview

Quince is a destination for builders, creators, innovators, and operators who want to come together and challenge the status quo. Our mission is simple: make really high quality essentials for really low prices, fairly and sustainably. We deliver on that mission through a unique manufacturer-to-consumer (M2C) model eliminating the layers of traditional retail that add cost and result in consumers paying more than they need to. We find, build relationships with, and work directly with the manufacturing partners behind some of the world’s finest products. From there, our teams design smart, efficient operational processes and build and deploy proprietary technology, AI, and analytics to help us scale fast.

What began with a small assortment of elevated basics has quickly grown into a cross-category brand spanning apparel, accessories, home goods, and more. Today, tens of millions of people across a growing number of countries come - and return - to Quince because they trust us to deliver.

OUR CULTURE

Quince is a culture built for builders by builders. Our way of working starts with a blank sheet of paper. We question conventional thinking, use technology and data to uncover new opportunities, and move quickly to turn ideas into reality. We aren’t interested in replicating how others do retail. We’re building a better way - at a speed and scale unlike anything that’s been done before.

• We dream big and chase the hard problems others shy away from. Rejecting long-held assumptions is part of our company's DNA. Where conventional wisdom says you have to choose - soft or durable, speed or rigor, quality or price - we ask why that trade-off has to exist in the first place.

• Our pace is fast and the bar is high because our customers expect a lot from us and we refuse to let them down. We believe the best results come from challenging ourselves, learning from one another, and building on each other's strengths.

If you’re someone who likes to imagine new possibilities and build better systems rather than plug-in to outdated ones, Quince is the place for you.
